properties.name: A quantity says how it was obtained and by what, a number nobody sourced is reported, and a check on a numeric limit with no executable form is reported
properties.rationale: "Asserted by the agent" is an allowed, visible state on purpose: the point is not to refuse a proposed number but to make one with no source look different from one with a source, and to count them at the boundary — the same discipline reflow2 applies to a requirement nobody confirmed. No design tool can rule out a made-up number; this is the whole of what one can do about it. Built on existing edge vocabulary (CONSTRAINS.basis was kept, and `source` added beside it) rather than a new Quantity type, per the over-engineering counterweight recorded on the brainstorm.
properties.summary: The second of the three requirements Anthony accepted on 2026-09-16 (req:a-quantity-carries-how-it-was-obtained-and-an-unsourced-one-is-reported), built on the units increment it depends on. THE HOMES: Constraint gains `limit_basis` (measured / computed / asserted, no default), `limit_source` (the instrument, artifact, check or person, by id) and `limit_measured_at`; CONSTRAINS gains `source` beside its existing `basis`/`measured_at`, stored only beside a contribution; TemporalFact gains `source` beside `basis`. THE SURFACE: add_constraint takes the three limit fields, constrains takes `source`, record_finding takes `source`; the core gains set_constraint_provenance, and constrains_in gains a source argument. THE READS: budget_report reports `limit_basis`, `limit_source` and `unsourced` (contributions with a number and no source — still totalled, but named). THE DETECTORS: `quantity_without_source` (a limit or a contribution with a number and no source; keyed on the set; silent when the design holds no numeric limit) and `quantity_check_without_executable_form` (a Verification that VERIFIES a Constraint with a limit and has no IMPLEMENTS from any Artifact — a claim wearing a status). THE INSTRUCTIONS: kpp-proposal and capture-intent ask where the number came from; genesis says every number says where it came from; detect-and-ask says how to answer each finding. THE PARTNERSHIP SENTENCE: constrains' own description now names `basis: measured` + `source` as the contract with an external measuring tool, and record_change's names `subject: record` as what a measurement fed back is — the two sentences the bhome report said were missing.
